page.title: Turn each decision into your own data.
page.description: Record simulated buys and sells, then see the updated holding, core shares, target shares, and cost basis. This page records decisions; it never places orders.

guide.title: Write it down before you decide again.
guide.description: Record one buy or sell so the new holding state can support the next reference.

steps.title: Choose a stock
steps.description: Pick one from your portfolio, or open this page from a stock detail view.

steps.title: Use the real numbers
steps.description: Enter the date, shares, execution price, and trading fee.

steps.title: Read the change
steps.description: Save and see the new holding, core shares, and cost basis right away.

form.title: Keep this decision in your notebook
form.description: This only records the event; it never sends an order. Sells are checked against your current holding.
form.stockHint: Only stocks already in your personal portfolio are shown.
form.positionEmptyHint: The change will appear here after saving.
form.sourceHint: Only helps you find the record later; it does not change the position calculation.

result.title: Understand today before recording again
result.description: Selected: {stock}. Use this small summary to check your position before saving.
result.placeholderTitle: A new position snapshot will appear after you save a record.
result.placeholderDescription: Complete the form and save it to receive the latest position state.
result.note: Today’s decision page will use this position to make the reference more personal.
result.emptyInputTitle: Enter shares and price to preview the change
result.emptyInputDescription: Check the amount and position change before saving, so the decision feels clear.
result.previewHint: This is only a preview; sells are still checked against your current holding.
result.savedDescription: The record is saved locally. Future portfolio references will use the updated position.
